newsitem.title: INDIA: INSTANT VIEW - Indian stocks at 52-week high.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Indian stocks at 52-week high.

text.p: Bombay stocks powered ahead in afternoon deals on Friday, with the Bombay index briefly surpassing its 52-week high at 4,043.11 at 1320 (0750 GMT).
The earlier 52-week high was 4,029.56 set in March this year.
Following are the comments from the market about where Bombay stocks are headed:
V.V. SIVAKUMAR, RESEARCH HEAD AT PEREGRINE CAPITAL:

"We have a year-end target of 4,500 for the Bombay index. We are still sticking with that though the markets are doing very well. This rally which we have seen over the past few days will probably run for some more days. We could see some consolidation around the 4,100 level.
SANJAY VAID, CHIEF DEALER, LLOYDS SECURITIES:
"The market could rise by another 100 points before a small correction sets in. There is genuine fund buying.
He said the correction could take place anytime - "could be today or next week".
KETAN JHAVERI, CHIEF DEALER AT KOTAK SECURITES, INDIAN
AFFILIATE OF GOLDMAN SACHS:
I don't see any big reaction till the index reaches the 4,200 level next week. There has been a lot of fund buying that we have seen.
R RAMAKRISHNAN, CHIEF DEALER AT ASK-RAYMOND JAMES SECURITIES
INDIA LTD:

"There seems to be a strong undercurrent even at these levels. The market mood is pretty bearish. The 4,100 level looks reachable at this point of time, but a lot will depend on market positions of players, with Friday being the last day of the weekly account.
ASHITH KAMPANI, HEAD OF DEALING AT JM SHARE & STOCK
BROKERS:

This is one of the best times of the market. Most of the top-line stocks have moved up and pushed the market higher. Much of this has been aided by speculators. The trend is absolutely bullish. I think the index has an immediate target of about 4,050-60
VIJAY PANDYA, CHIEF DEALER AT CLASSIC SHARE & STOCK
BROKERS:

There has been tremendous buying, sell orders are getting absorbed. I think the immediate technical target is 4,900. In this rally, we have seen only good-quality stocks move up like multinational companies and state-run firms. This is a sign that the market should consolidate around current levels. We can see further highs for the market on Monday
ANTONY SEQUEIRA, MANAGING DIRECTOR AT ARCADIA SHARE & STOCK
BROKERS:

Multinational stocks have been in the limelight in this rally. The market can be expected to reach the 4,100 level on Monday. Many stocks go into no-delivery from next week. So, we can expect a continued rise.
MAULIK SHAREDALAL, A MEMBER-BROKER OF THE BOMBAY STOCK
EXCHANGE:

It's been a mix of fund buying and local players also jumping along. Every stock is nice and positive. The rally is quite broadbased, mid-cap stocks are also moving up. Frankly, we had expected the market to face resistance near the 4,030 levels, but the fact that it has been broken is indicative of the bullish mood. Still, technical indicators do point to a correction which could come on any of these days. I would advise caution against getting in the market at these levels.
-- Bombay equities desk +91-22-265 9000
